items.title: Hard enforcement or it does not exist
items.summary: Every agreed requirement and every researched technique is built into code that executes it, with a check or test that fails when it is not executed. Researching or merely including something is not done.

evidence.finding: ALL THE POINTS SHOULD BE ACTUALLY HARD ENFORCED, NOT JUST INCLUDED FOR NAMESAKE

items.title: Breakout first, money second, savings never the goal
items.summary: Breakout is the primary goal. Money comes second and saving money is never a goal: savings only buy more breakout attempts. Every output - long video, Short, spin-off - is engineered for breakout with do-or-die urgency.

evidence.finding: savings is not the primary motive. Breakout is always first.

items.title: The owner has 1-2 minutes a day on a phone
items.summary: Do the maximum without the owner. A step that truly needs him is ONE tap, pre-filled and babysat, sent as a card. He never opens a laptop to keep the channel running.

evidence.finding: 1-2 minutes a day on a phone; wants the maximum done for him and every owner step pre-filled and babysat

items.title: Never make the owner repeat himself
items.summary: Whatever the owner said once is recorded once and honoured everywhere. Never ask him to retype or restate a requirement he already gave.

evidence.finding: I HATE IT WHEN I HAVE TO TYPE AGAIN SO MUCH AGAIN AND AGAIN REPEATEDLY TO REMIND YOU OF ALL POINTERS

items.title: Answer first, short, brutally honest
items.summary: Every message to the owner gives the answer first, short, brutally honest, sharp and witty. Say plainly what is not built. Never claim something is done before a test proves it.

evidence.finding: brutally honest, sharp, witty answers; never make him retype

items.title: The pipeline is strictly structured and never left broken
items.summary: Everything runs on planned timings with buffers, retries, timeouts and fallbacks. No stale references, no silly or small faults, nothing that makes the owner come back to repair code during setup.

evidence.finding: make sure pipeline is not broken or any stale or any faults, even silly or small ones, are not left out

items.title: The writers' room learns every time
items.summary: The writers' room must learn from research, R&D and the channel's own data to improve its performance every time it writes.

evidence.finding: The writer room also should learn from researcher and R&D to enhance their performance everytime

items.title: Cheap models never make taste calls
items.summary: Cheap models never make taste, creative or strategic decisions. Strong, cross-family, blind judges see EVERY candidate; cheap models only do mechanical work such as formatting, de-duplication and extraction.

evidence.finding: how much can a good model also improve a cheap topic?

items.title: Money: Rs 5,000 a month, everything included
items.summary: Rs 5,000 a month TOTAL from December 2026, everything included: retries, failures, buffers, fallback plans, research and the organisation's own thinking. November 2026 only: Rs 5,226 (Rs 4,000 approved for the rest of the month on top of what was spent). No new subscriptions.

evidence.source: owner, build chat (handoff 02, A.1 and A.4)
evidence.finding: For November remaining days, i can approve 4000 for this month. From next month, back to 5000 from beginning for whole month.

items.title: Freed money is reinvested in breakout, with a veto
items.summary: Money that is saved is reinvested by a ladder - breakout follow-ups first, then more hook-test Shorts, then more animated Shorts or quality. Each step is a card the owner can veto, and the change undoes itself at month end.

evidence.source: owner, build chat (handoff 02, A.5 and A.6)
evidence.finding: if we see that money is getting saved, will the remainder be utilized in some best value adding manner

items.title: Breakout fund: unspent money carries over, capped
items.summary: Last month's unspent money carries over into a breakout fund capped at Rs 1,000. It may be spent ONLY on breakout follow-ups.

evidence.source: owner approval recorded in the requirements ledger, section C
evidence.finding: Breakout fund: last month's unspent carries over, capped Rs 1,000, ONLY for breakout follow-ups. Owner-approved.

items.title: Never cut these to save money
items.summary: Never cut to save money: packaging tests, the accuracy pass, the opening animated scene, the reserve. Long-episode money is reserved before any extra.

evidence.source: owner-approved money rules, requirements ledger section C
evidence.finding: Never cut: packaging tests, accuracy pass, the opening Kling scene, the reserve.

items.title: Launch cadence: 4 long videos a month, one a week
items.summary: 4 long videos a month, one a week (Saturday, US Eastern). Each long video is built to break out; daily Shorts and the two spin-offs carry the volume. Changing this needs the owner.

evidence.source: owner, build session, answer to: launch month 4 long videos or up to 8?
evidence.finding: 4 a month

items.title: Plans change mid-month when findings say so
items.summary: Posting plans may change mid-month on findings or ideas, always inside the remaining budget. The pipeline does this proactively and automatically for the best breakout chance at every opportunity.

evidence.finding: We can change the plans of posting mid month also depending upon findings or ideas and all, still managing within the remaining budget

items.title: The show is Reality on Trial - do not re-open
items.summary: The channel is Reality on Trial (brand Reality Engine): a science what-if is put on trial in a Toybox Noir stop-motion puppet courtroom. The owner chose to complete this concept on 9 Nov 2026 after exploring alternatives; do not re-open it.

evidence.finding: can you please continue from there as if we were to complete the reality on trial project file?

items.title: The product is a feeling: it happens to YOU
items.summary: People must RELATE and FEEL: it happens to YOU, first person, inside the scene, my body. The product is a feeling - dread, wonder, scale, awe, shock - with witty relatable humour, never a lecture. Nobody cares about a number changing by seconds a year; they care what it does to them.

evidence.finding: People want to relate and feel ... the content should be entertaining ... that people take such a mind impression and feel that they would want to come back

items.title: Weird titles, edge, characters to love, a reason to return
items.summary: Titles are weird and mind-piercing. The channel is edgy and never monotonous, with characters people fall in love with and a reason to come back. Never one more channel in a crowded pool of the same idea.

evidence.source: owner, standing requirements 6-9 Nov 2026 (handoff 02, B) and A.7
evidence.finding: very common known ideas would be adding me to another candidate to a pool, who already posts such

items.title: No AI slop, no repetition
items.summary: Nothing may look or sound machine-made, and nothing may repeat last time's template. Variety is required for the long term.

evidence.finding: want to avoid repititive things for long term and AI slop

items.title: Audience: non-science viewers too, Tier-1, sponsor-ready
items.summary: Appeal to non-science viewers too. Aim at Tier-1 audiences (US, UK, CA, AU) with high RPM, and stay sponsor-ready.

evidence.finding: appeal to non-science viewers; Tier-1 audiences, high RPM, sponsor-ready

items.title: Concepts explored and not adopted
items.summary: Explored and NOT adopted - do not re-propose unless the owner asks: a plain what-if or 'who would win' channel; a 'Science verdict' packaging tweak; 'Sentenced' (real nature charged with crimes - the owner found it boring); small-claims court.

evidence.source: owner, build chat (handoff 02, A.7); requirements ledger section B
evidence.finding: This also sounds boring to me atleast

items.title: CASE FILE: YOU is parked
items.summary: CASE FILE: YOU is parked (viewer-as-victim whodunit with personified culprits and nostalgia seasoning): the owner liked the premise but chose to complete Reality on Trial. Its ideas may return only as an R&D proposal that wins in the Council and passes tests, for example a nostalgia sensory cold open as an experiment arm.

evidence.source: owner, build chat (handoff 02, A.7 outcome and A.10)
evidence.finding: owner later chose to COMPLETE Reality on Trial

items.title: Inspiration the owner named: Soft Respawn and Zuni HR
items.summary: The owner named two Instagram pages as inspiration (9 Nov 2026): Soft Respawn and Zuni HR - first-person nostalgia that makes memories feel real, 'ASMR for eyes and ears' combined with the theme. Copy the grammar, never the IP.

evidence.finding: Soft Respawn was just awesome, i mean it was ASMR for eyes and ears well combined with theme

items.title: Personify the channel; add flavour and attachment
items.summary: Personify the channel concept a little: give it flavour, connection and attachment that raise the odds of a breakout. Breakout is the purpose, simple.

evidence.finding: Try to personify the channel concept or idea a little ... breakout is my primary purpose, simple

items.title: Long videos: sound that matches and changes with the scene
items.summary: Owner idea: long videos can hold people with pleasing ASMR-like sound that matches and changes with the scenes, at no extra cost. Research verdict recorded with it: use such textures as touches inside scenes, never in hooks.

evidence.finding: people can be retained with pleasing ASMR sounds or sounds extremely matching and changing with the scenes

items.title: Cheap long videos and spin-offs are built to break out too
items.summary: The cheaper long videos and the spin-offs are also designed for breakout with the best tactics, using available resources and no extra cost. A spin-off is a value-adding breakout attempt, not filler.

evidence.finding: This spin off thing is also very nice. It can be also a value adding breakout attempt part.

items.title: The project works like an organisation with one Knowledge Palace
items.summary: Every department researches, assesses research, creates, brainstorms and decides; writes a key takeaway from every session into one ever-growing Knowledge Palace; learns BOTH WAYS from every other department; and sends problem memos back for brainstorm and repair. Autonomous and self-developing.

evidence.finding: IT SHOULD BECOME A LARGE PALACE OF LEARNING AND FULL AUTOMATION EVER LEARNING BRAIN FOR MY PROJECT ... THE WHOLE PROJECT SHOULD FUNCTION LIKE AN ORGANISATION

items.title: Whatever is learned or decided is executed in code
items.summary: Whatever any department learns, brainstorms or decides is executed at code-line level and hard-enforced everywhere - tested, rehearsed, executed and re-looped until corrected. Never left as words in a file.

evidence.finding: whatever they learn or brainstorm or decide, that should also be strictly code line level executed and enforced as well pervasively

items.title: Departments pass memos that another role judges objectively
items.summary: Owner idea: a department or researcher sends memo details or batches that another session evaluates objectively in its role, for maximum output - adopted where research supports it (parallel drafts judged by a blind cross-family jury), with cost and timing planned. If the cost effect is bad, drop it.

evidence.finding: memo details or batches which are sent by a one department to other or by researcher and is evaluated by another chat session objectively in its role

items.title: The first 3 long videos and first 3 Shorts wait for Approve
items.summary: The first 3 long videos and the first 3 Shorts are held private until the owner taps Approve on the review card.

evidence.source: owner-approved review gate, requirements ledger section G
evidence.finding: First 3 long videos + first 3 Shorts wait for the owner's Approve card.

items.title: Build the blind test of the writers' room against a single prompt
items.summary: The owner decided to BUILD the blind test that compares the writers' room script with a single-prompt script for the same premise, judged blind by strong judges of another model family, with the win rate shown to him. It had been promised by three Settings cells and a tab and was never built. It belongs to the learning loop.

evidence.source: owner, build chat of 10 Nov 2026 (asked: build it with the learning loop, or drop it)
evidence.finding: build
